The bursts are now huge. My test burst was about 600px across, roughly three-quarters of the screen's height, and it covered the robot, title, buttons and both text columns.

**What changed:**
- **Size:** bursts scale with your window, so they stay about half the screen across at any size.
- **Colour:** about half the bursts sweep the whole rainbow around the circle. The rest use a mixed palette with an outer ring and an inner core in contrasting colours.
- **More fireworks:** each burst has about 470 sparks instead of 90, with longer trails, and they hang in the air about twice as long before fading.
- **Crackles:** some sparks pop into small bursts of their own partway out, and sparks twinkle as they fade.
- I capped the total number of sparks so the page stays smooth if you click a lot.

**What I checked:** I faked a click, waited about a second and took a screenshot. It showed the full rainbow burst with crackles going off inside it, and there were no errors. The "Get it" confetti is unchanged.
